subject: Launch orchestration: milestone matrix & ops play for Novaforge
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@novaforge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha M. <aisha@novaforge.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T15:12:00Z
Subject: Launch orchestration: milestone matrix & ops play for Novaforge

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Leadership gave the green light to proceed toward a phased go-live targeting Aug 1. Before we lock dates with our procurement and cloud teams we need a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) and an owner-level milestone matrix that shows: key milestones, who owns them at Redwood and Novaforge, hard dependencies (security, infra provisioning, SSO), and acceptance gates.

Can you send a draft MAP and a recommended kickoff window? We expect a short SOW redline and a security questionnaire next week — so any way to parallelize delivery would be helpful.

Also flag any capacity or SLA assumptions up front (we might need burst capacity for initial indexing).

Thanks —
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Engineering Programs, Novaforge
liam@novaforge.com

Attachment: Novaforge_RFP_summary.pdf (reference only)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novaforge.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Launch orchestration: milestone matrix & ops play for Novaforge

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Novaforge_MAP_draft.xlsx) that aligns milestones to owners and dependency lanes. High level notes:

- Go-live target: 2026-08-01 (phase 1: read-only + search; phase 2: write + personalization TBD)
- Proposed kickoff: week of 2026-06-14 (60–90 minute alignment + MOPs review)
- Redwood owners (proposed): Vivek (Commercial AE), Naomi (Customer Success / Onboarding), Jordan (Integrations / Eng QA), Ben (CS Ops / Bridge)
- Key external dependencies: SSO config, Dedicated GPU provisioning, SOC2 evidence for select logs (security review), and initial dataset export from Novaforge
- Risk: indexing bulk load will require reserved capacity windows — recommend a one-week reservation during onboarding and a burst plan thereafter

Next actions I propose: 1) Kickoff invite -> align attendees and agenda; 2) Naomi to draft milestone calendar with acceptance criteria; 3) Ben to prepare cutover runbook and bridge schedule; 4) We share the SOW redline link (DocuSign) so Novaforge can route procurement in parallel.

I'll wait for your preferred kickoff slots.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Novaforge_MAP_draft.xlsx

On 2026-06-03 15:12, Liam O'Connor wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo last week. Leadership gave the green light...

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@novaforge.com>, Aisha M. <aisha@novaforge.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Launch orchestration: milestone matrix & ops play for Novaforge

Thanks for the draft, Vivek — I reviewed and sketched a milestone cadence below. I've kept dates conservative to allow for security and provisioning windows.

Proposed milestone matrix (owners and target dates):
- Week 1 (2026-06-14): Kickoff + architecture review (Vivek/Naomi/Novaforge eng)
- Week 2–3 (2026-06-21 to 2026-07-02): SSO + network allowlists (Novaforge lead / Jordan as tech owner)
- Week 3–4 (2026-06-28 to 2026-07-09): Dedicated capacity provisioning & validation (Ben/Jordan)
- Week 5 (2026-07-12): Initial indexing dry run (Naomi/Novaforge data lead) — acceptance: search results parity for sample queries
- Week 6 (2026-07-19): Full indexing window (scheduled reserved capacity) — acceptance: index completeness and perf targets met
- Week 7 (2026-07-26): Cutover rehearsal + rollback plan validation (Ben/Naomi)
- Week 8 (2026-08-01): Phase 1 go-live (monitoring + bridge)

Dependencies and notes:
- Security questionnaire: Novaforge already flagged SOC2 snippets; we will run a 3-day evidence pull — early heads up to our Trust team helps parallelize.
- Procurement SOW: if Novaforge can sign the DocuSign link this week we can start provisioning earlier (Ben to track).
- Acceptance criteria: each milestone will have a short test checklist (I will attach once we finalize).

I can own the onboarding milestones and the final acceptance checklist. Ben — can you confirm the provisioning lead/ETA for reserved GPU windows? Jordan — please confirm expected SSO steps (IdP metadata + test accounts).

Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

On 2026-06-04 09:02, Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a first-pass MAP...

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novaforge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Launch orchestration: milestone matrix & ops play for Novaforge

Liam / Aisha — looping back with a concise set of commitments and next steps so procurement and your program team have a single reference.

Committed milestones and owners (single-line):
- Kickoff (2026-06-15): Redwood owners: Vivek / Naomi / Jordan / Ben — agenda to include security, provisioning, data extract map
- SSO + allowlist (complete by 2026-07-02): Jordan lead (Redwood), Novaforge lead: Aisha
- Provisioning validated (complete by 2026-07-09): Ben lead (Redwood infra ops) — note: requires signed SOW to start reserved GPU allocation
- Index dry run (2026-07-12): Naomi / Novaforge data lead -> success criteria: sample queries return expected results within 95th percentile perf target
- Full index + cutover rehearsal (2026-07-19 to 2026-07-26): Ben / Naomi -> runbook validated
- Phase 1 go-live (2026-08-01): monitoring and 48h bridge staffed by Redwood CS Ops

Immediate actions for Novaforge:
1) Complete the short procurement step and sign SOW (DocuSign link provided) so we can allocate GPUs.
2) Share IdP metadata and 2 test accounts for SSO integration.
3) Provide initial dataset extract (sample) by 2026-06-18.

I've attached the draft MAP and the SOW PDF for procurement to review. I'll send a calendar invite for the 2026-06-15 kickoff (30–60 min) with the proposed agenda. If you need the reserved capacity earlier, let me know and we'll surface a cost estimate for a one-week early reservation.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Novaforge_MAP_draft.xlsx; Novaforge_SOW_Redwood_v1.pdf
